answer: In PoA, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted trust matrix, while temporal decay applies an exponential half-life to earned reputation. Sustained honest service is therefore required to retain eigenvector centrality; a freshly spawned sybil starts with near-zero centrality, lacks trusted incoming mass, and cannot cross the consensus threshold. Factorization may use ridge regularization, but no garden of fabricated accounts can amplify influence from a disconnected ledge.
